ResearchTabDef.label: Warehouse
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: Research high-density storage, warehouse cores and conveyor logistics.

ResearchProjectDef.label: tier 1 vertical warehouse
ResearchProjectDef.description: Stackable items hold 10x their normal limit. Requires Electricity.

ResearchProjectDef.label: tier 2 vertical warehouse
ResearchProjectDef.description: Stackable items hold 30x their normal limit (another 3x). Unlocks the vertical warehouse core, which cools its enclosed room toward 4 degrees C when powered.

ResearchProjectDef.label: tier 3 vertical warehouse
ResearchProjectDef.description: Stackable items hold 60x their normal limit (another 2x). Unlocks conveyors; the warehouse core can be set from -20 to 30 degrees C.
